Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[Xizor's Palace: Sewer (Errata)]] (PC-E1), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Once per game, if you control, may retrieve a Corellian. '''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may exchange an alien in hand with a non-spy Black Sun agent in Lost Pile.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/March_2020_Errata.pdf Errata Sheet 2020 Spring] (Players Committee), page 1, PDF built 22 March 2020. The slip was cut from the page rendered at 300 dpi (the PDF draws its text over a background image), at the slip's outline.

Edits: none.
